summary: the cases of tests/run uefi under etude, against a kernel that leaves Doom's picture on the screen once the game has gone, a bootctl grub that writes the new tail and leaves the entry sector naming the old one, and a diskctl relocate that writes neither table

argv: { [ -f krffs/recovery_authorized_keys ] || make -s recovery-key; } && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 utils && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel utils/sbin/bootctl utils/diskctl

faults.name: picture-kept
faults.summary: the kernel ends the game's hold on the screen without painting the console's cells again, so the picture stays

faults.name: entry-kept
faults.summary: bootctl grub writes the core into the other tail and says so, but leaves the entry sector naming the tail that ran

edits.find: if (io(ctx, w->entry, scratch, 0) != 0 || memcmp(scratch, image, BOOTSLOT_SECTOR) != 0) {

faults.name: primary-kept
faults.summary: diskctl relocate says the primary table was written again from the backup and writes nothing
